item.title: A French Village Becomes a Ghost Town After the Wildfires
item.description: Wildfires in France have forced tens of thousands of people from their homes and left entire towns deserted along the southwest coast. We visited Claouey, an empty beach town, and found a handful of residents who chose to stay, including one man who’s made it his mission to care for all the village pets.
item.dc:creator: Bethlehem Feleke, Alex Pena, Michael Anthony Adams, Mark Boyer and Yasu Tsuji

item.title: Trump Administration Is Undoing Plans to Boost Workplace Heat Protections
item.description: The Biden administration took steps to shield workers from extreme temperatures. The Trump administration is taking a gentler approach with employers.

item.media:description: A delivery in Wilmington, N.C., this month. Heat is linked to hundreds of workplace deaths each year, but labor groups say the true toll is unknown because heat-related illnesses are not properly tracked or reported.

item.title: Trump’s Fixation on Arctic Ships Led to Billions in No-Bid Contracts

item.media:description: A burned area in the town of Le Porge on Monday, following a wildfire in southwestern France.

item.title: Civilians Battle Wildfire Threatening Bordeaux
item.description: Residents in Bordeaux in southwestern France are doing everything in their power to stop a wildfire that’s been burning for more than a week. The flames are too spread out for professional firefighters to be everywhere, so for now, civilian volunteers are the only thing standing between the fire and a major French city.
